verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that Lever's AI drafts job descriptions, outreach sequences, or rejection notes, in the recruiter's tone or otherwise. The AI items it does contain cover other outputs: onboarding forms (AI Form Builder), interview questions, and interview transcripts and summaries. The nurture and Automation Hub items describe automated sending, not AI-written copy, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context
